identifiers.identifier_scope: Ad5-encoding IFNg SP-002 is identified by its investigational code SP-002.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Ad5-encoding IFNg SP-002 is a gene therapy that uses an adenovirus vector to deliver the interferon gamma (IFNg) gene directly into tumor cells, leading to the production of IFNg, which can stimulate an immune response against the tumor.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The adenovirus vector delivers the IFNg gene into cells, resulting in the expression of IFNg protein, which activates immune cells and enhances anti-tumor immunity.

typical_use.scope: Investigational use in clinical trials for solid tumors.

data_notes.record_scope: This record is focused on the investigational gene therapy Ad5-encoding IFNg SP-002, detailing its clinical, biological, and pharmacokinetic properties.
